skill.summary: Plan, track, and deliver projects using tailored frameworks, ensuring scope clarity, risk management, schedule control, and stakeholder alignment for on-time...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — comprehensive project management skill using proven frameworks, templates, and best practices.

- Guides users through project intake, scoping, and methodology selection.
- Provides structured Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) templates and rules.
- Introduces a three-point estimation method and common estimation checklists.
- Details scheduling, milestone planning, and critical path management.
- Features an actionable risk management framework and top 10 risk mitigations.
- Supplies standardized status update and escalation guidance.
- Covers agile workflow ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Standup, Review, Retro) when appropriate.
